title: build: do not leak context tmpdir
body:
I was looking at #22642 and traced it to ParseBuildOpts: it downloads a URL or stdin context into a temp dir and stores it in TmpDirToClose, but the caller only removes that when the whole parse succeeds, so every error return after the download leaks the directory. built the tree with and without the patch and ran the reproducer from the issue:

```
== main: build --authfile=/nonexistent - ==
Error: credential file is not accessible: faccessat /nonexistent/authfile.json: no such file or directory
leftover in TMPDIR: buildah408229798 (count 1)
== fix: same command ==
leftover in TMPDIR: (count 0)
```

same guard TempDirForURL itself uses, one level up so it covers both tmpdir call sites and the logfile next to them. added a system test that runs the same reproducer.

Fixes: #22642
